item.title: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against enterprises of Ukraine’s defence industry, port infrastru
item.description: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against enterprises of Ukraine’s defence industry, port infrastructure facilities, and vessels used to deliver military cargo to Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strike, the electronic industry enterprise (STE "UKRSPETSYSVYAZ" LLC) was damaged. It is located in the settlement of Nadtochii of Kharkov region, and manufactures automation systems and communication equipment for the AFU. 💥 In addition, a cargo ship delivering supplies to the port of Odessa for the AFU was damaged at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤌 Clean job In Dnepropetrovsk direction, the Tsentr Group's sniper pairs perform two essential tasks at once:
item.description: Clean job 🤌 🤝 In Dnepropetrovsk direction, the Tsentr Group's sniper pairs perform two essential tasks at once: protect assault groups from enemy drones and destroy camouflaged enemy observation posts. 💡 It is difficult to find such posts: the enemy hides well. However, our snipers have come up with a clever trick: they use the movements of enemy drones to spot the enemy's positions. 💬 The sniper company commander with the call sign 'Khudozhnik' said: 'We spot such enemy by drops from Baba Yaga. Goods are sent to them. We see these actions, move covertly to the position where these packages are delivered. We wait for the moment when he comes to a package to destroy him'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 27 October 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 27 October 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) ↗️ The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence. Russian elements engaged manpower and hardware of an air assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, and a marine brigade close to Trudoolenovka, Tersyanka, Volnyanka, Barvinovka, Vasilevskoye in Zaporozhye region, and Gavrilovka in Dnepropetrovsk region. ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 195 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, three motor vehicles, and one artillery gun. 📍 The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line. Formations of a mechanised brigade and a mountain assault brigade of the AFU were hit near Preobrazhenka and Orekhov of Zaporozhye region. ▪️ Up to 30 troops and nine motor vehicles of the AFU were neutralised. ✈️ Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on transport infrastructure facilities used by the AFU, ammunition depots, production workshops, and storage areas of unmanned ground and long-range unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 148 areas. ▫️ Air defence systems shot down two guided aerial bombs and 645 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. 📊 In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost: ▫️ 674 aircraft, ▫️ 284 helicopter

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
▫️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade and two assault regiments of the AFU close to Bugayevka, Rubezhnoye, Velikiy Burluk, Izbitskoye, and Stary Saltov of Kharkov region.
📍
In Sumy region,
formations of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades
were hit
near Sukhodol, Luzhki, Vakalovshchina, and Proletarskoye (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 165 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, and 11 motor vehicles.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Studenok, Smorodkovka, Glushchenkovo, Nizhneye Solenoye, Monatchinovka (Kharkov region), Donetskoye and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 230 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Russian elements engaged formations of two mechanised brigades, an air assault brigade, a mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and a marine brigades close to Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, Kamyshevakha, Kondratovka, and Semenovka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 150 troops, eight armoured fighting vehicles, 41 motor vehicles, one Czech-made Vampire MLRS combat vehicle, and one artillery gun.
▫️
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and three national guard brigades near Yakovlevka, Starovarvarovka, Verovka, Viktorovka, Krinitsy, Kalinino, Belozerskoye, Novofedorovka, Shilovka, and Svyatogorovka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 345 troops, one tank, three armoured fighting vehicles, 13 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
👉

item.title: ▫️ We took what's ours! During the assault of Obshcheye , the Vostok Group's servicemen had to break through the enemy's powerful defence system.
item.description: We took what's ours! During the assault of Obshcheye , the Vostok Group's servicemen had to break through the enemy's powerful defence system. ▫️ Our lads liberated the settlement, moved more than 5 kilometres forward, crossed the Solenaya River, and mopped up an area of more than 12 square kilometres from the AFU. 💬 The deputy platoon leader with the call sign 'Berkut' spoke about advancing to the settlement and the enemy's equipped positions: 'Sometimes, you come over 500 metres in five minutes, but sometimes, it takes a whole day. The enemy intensively operates with FPV drones and heavy drones with drop systems, and mines approaches. They had well-equipped dugouts, strongholds, machine gun positions'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike with ground-based high-precision weapons and unmanned aerial vehicles against enterprises of the Ukrainian defence industry and transport infrastructure in Kiev, a logistics centre in Kharkov region, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result, the following targets were hit 📍 in Kiev: ▫️ an industrial enterprise producing and storing long- and medium-range unmanned aerial vehicles; ▫️ the Oakline LLC unmanned aerial vehicle assembly workshop, which produces and stores long- and medium-range FP-1 and FP-2 unmanned aerial vehicles of Fire Point company; ▫️ an unmanned aerial vehicle assembly workshop producing and storing long- and medium-range fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles; ▫️ the Yuzhny road-rail bridge used for the transit of military cargo by road and rail; 📍 in Kharkov region: ▫️ the unloading and customs terminal of the Regional Logistics Centre LLC used to store and distribute materiel, dual-use cargo intended for supply of the AFU, as well as reconnaissance and attack UAVs. 🔥 In addition, a dry cargo vessel , delivering cargo to the port of Chernomorsk in Odessa region to support the AFU, was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
